clips.title: The story
paras: Warrior trainers across Azeroth send proven fighters to Fray Island for a test among their peers. The island lies off the Merchant Coast, where chief warrior Klannoc Macleod awaits those who seek the next step in their training.

Warrior trainers in Alliance and Horde capitals send students who have outgrown basic drills to test themselves against their peers. A fighter's progress comes through combat, not rank or loyalty. The journey leads away from civilized sparring yards to a rugged isle in the Great Sea.

Fray Island lies east of the Merchant Coast, just south of Ratchet in the Barrens. You can reach it by swimming across waters that pass over submerged sandbar shallows. Political ties matter little on the island, where fighters gather before Klannoc Macleod, its chief warrior, and await the trial he chooses.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Your renown as a warrior grows, friend. Now it is time to pit yourself against your peers and see where you stand.
There is an island off the coast of the Barrens, south of Ratchet. It is called Fray Island and it is a place where warriors meet.
Speak with the chief warrior of Fray Island, Klannoc Macleod. If he finds you worthy, then Klannoc will lead you further down the warrior's path.
To reach Fray Island, search for the sand bar shallows along the Merchant Coast.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hello, warrior. It's good to see you made it to Fray Island. I hope you find it to your liking...
